capabilities: Rename, merge and delete tags with usage counts
Find and merge probable duplicate tags
Rename, delete or set properties across the vault
Find and replace plain text or regex with folder scope
Preview a diff per note and undo batches
disambiguation: Not a Markdown or whitespace formatter; it bulk-edits tags, properties and text across notes.
extras: Freemium: the AI duplicate finder and tag suggestions need a paid Pro license (one license covers up to 3 devices); Pro requests go to a Cloudflare Workers AI endpoint and send only tag names with counts or the title and first 1,500 characters of chosen notes; undo snapshots are kept locally in history.json.
problem: Cleaning up tags, properties and repeated text across many notes otherwise means editing files one at a time with no safe preview or way to roll back.
summary: Bulk vault cleanup tool that renames, merges and deletes tags, edits properties and runs find & replace, with a preview diff and one-click undo.
